summary_en: Trust accounting, owner statements, commissions and brokerage back office.
summary_fr: Comptabilité mandant, reddition de comptes, commissions et back-office d'agence.

tools.name: Aareon
tools.positioning: The European ERP of social and institutional housing — where the tenant file, the rent and the works order live together.
tools.description: Aareon provides enterprise property management software for social landlords, institutional owners and large managers across Europe, with a French organisation serving bailleurs sociaux: tenant and lease management, rent and charge accounting, allocation processes, maintenance and tenant self-service portals.
tools.real_estate_use: French social housing operates under rules no commercial system covers: regulated rents, the allocation commission, the surface and resource ceilings, the supplément de loyer. Aareon's French deployments encode those processes, which is why the sector runs on specialised ERPs rather than on general property management platforms.
features: Tenant, lease and allocation management for regulated housing
Rent and charge accounting with regulatory rules
Maintenance and works order management
Tenant self-service portal and digital services
Asset and patrimony management
Regulatory and management reporting

use_cases.job: Run regulated allocation and rent processes for a social housing portfolio
Hold asset, lease and works data for a large institutional patrimony in one ERP

tools.name: AppFolio Property Manager
tools.positioning: The mid-market property management system that made cloud-native and mobile-first the default expectation.
tools.description: AppFolio is an all-in-one property management platform covering residential, commercial, student and community association portfolios: marketing and leasing, applicant screening, online payments, maintenance, full trust accounting and owner reporting, with AI features branded Realm.
tools.real_estate_use: A management company running a few thousand units uses it as the system of record for the whole operation. A vacancy is syndicated to the rental portals, an applicant is screened and signs a lease online, rent arrives by ACH, a maintenance request from the tenant app becomes a work order to a vendor, and the owner receives a statement generated from the same ledger. The differentiator in practice is that the accounting is genuinely built in, not bolted on.
features: Vacancy marketing with syndication to rental portals
Online applications, screening and lease e-signature
Online rent collection and utility billing
Maintenance work orders with vendor management and a 24/7 call answering option
Full trust accounting, owner statements and 1099 handling
Resident and owner portals with mobile apps

use_cases.job: Run leasing, rent, maintenance and owner accounting for thousands of units in one ledger
Receive an owner statement generated from the actual accounting rather than a spreadsheet

tools.name: Baselane
tools.positioning: Banking and bookkeeping in one product — a separate account per property, without opening ten accounts at a bank.
tools.description: Baselane provides landlord banking with virtual accounts per property, rent collection, automated bookkeeping against a real estate chart of accounts, and reporting. It combines the deposit account and the accounting layer that would normally be two vendors.
tools.real_estate_use: Commingling funds across properties is the classic small-landlord accounting failure, and the usual fix — a bank account per property — is administratively painful. Virtual accounts give the same separation with one relationship, and because the money movement and the bookkeeping share a system, categorisation is automatic rather than reconciled later.
features: Landlord banking with virtual accounts per property or unit
Rent collection by ACH and card with automatic matching
Automated bookkeeping to a real estate chart of accounts
Security deposit segregation
Cash flow and tax reporting per property
Rent analysis and landlord loan options

use_cases.job: Keep funds separated per property without opening an account for each one
Have rent, expenses and books reconcile automatically instead of monthly

tools.name: Batappli
tools.positioning: A long-standing French building trades package covering quote, invoice and accounting in one product.
tools.description: Batappli is management software for French construction and trade businesses: quotes and invoices with work libraries, progress billing, purchase and stock, site follow-up, customer records and integrated accounting, available on desktop and cloud.
tools.real_estate_use: Its buyer is the established trade business that wants one supplier for commercial documents and books rather than a modern SaaS plus an accountant's package. The integrated accounting is the differentiator: the invoice posts directly, so the year-end handover to the expert-comptable is a file rather than a reconstruction.
features: Quotes and invoices with trade work libraries
Progress billing and deposit management
Purchase orders, suppliers and stock
Site follow-up and cost tracking
Integrated accounting and ledger
Customer records and payment follow-up

use_cases.job: Keep commercial documents and accounting in one package for the year-end handover
Produce trade quotes from a maintained work and price library

tools.name: BoldTrail
tools.positioning: The brokerage-scale platform that grew out of kvCORE — websites, CRM, recruiting and back office under one roof.
tools.description: BoldTrail is Inside Real Estate's platform, the successor branding to kvCORE. It is sold at brokerage and enterprise level and spans agent websites, a CRM with automated campaigns, listing marketing, recruiting and retention tooling, and — through BoldTrail BackOffice (the former Brokermint) — commission and transaction accounting.
tools.real_estate_use: A multi-office brokerage standardises its agents on one system: each agent gets a branded IDX site and CRM seat, the brokerage keeps ownership of the lead database, and leadership sees production, recruiting pipeline and commission splits in the same tool. It is chosen for the consolidation rather than for any single best-in-class module.
features: Agent, team and brokerage IDX websites with lead capture
CRM with behavioural automation and mass texting
Listing marketing kits and social ad automation
Recruiting and retention module with agent production data
BackOffice for commission plans, disbursement and brokerage accounting
Marketplace of add-ons for ads, video and lead sources

use_cases.job: Give 500 agents a website and CRM without losing brokerage ownership of the data
Track recruiting targets against real production numbers pulled from the MLS

capabilities: AI content assistant for listing and campaign copy

tools.name: BoldTrail BackOffice (Brokermint)
tools.positioning: Where a closed transaction becomes a commission calculation, an agent statement and an accounting entry.
tools.description: Brokermint — now sold as BoldTrail BackOffice — handles the brokerage side of a deal: commission plans, splits, caps, fees, agent billing, 1099 preparation and accounting export. Transaction management and e-signature sit alongside it so the same file feeds both compliance and money.
tools.real_estate_use: The problem it solves is that commission structures are individually negotiated. A brokerage encodes each agent's split, cap and fee schedule once, and every closing then produces a disbursement authorisation and an agent statement automatically. Year-end 1099 preparation stops being a spreadsheet exercise.
features: Commission plans with splits, caps, tiers and referral fees
Automatic disbursement authorisations and agent statements
Agent billing for monthly fees and chargebacks
Transaction management with document checklists and e-signature
QuickBooks export and accounting reconciliation
Production reporting by agent, office and team

use_cases.job: Calculate every agent's commission automatically from their negotiated plan
Produce year-end 1099s and agent statements without rebuilding a spreadsheet

tools.name: Buildium
tools.positioning: The property management system a small management company can actually implement without a project team.
tools.description: Buildium covers residential rentals, community associations and affordable housing: listings, applications and screening, leases, rent collection, maintenance, accounting and owner reporting, with published per-unit pricing and self-serve onboarding. Now part of RealPage.
tools.real_estate_use: It sits at the tier below AppFolio and Entrata: a company managing a few hundred doors, often mixed between rentals and homeowner associations. The HOA module handles association dues, violations and architectural requests, which is why small managers with both books of business consolidate here rather than run two systems.
features: Listings, applications and tenant screening
Lease management with e-signature and renewals
Online rent and association dues collection
Maintenance requests, work orders and vendor payments
Property, owner and association accounting with 1099s
Resident, owner and board member portals

use_cases.job: Manage a few hundred rental doors without a dedicated systems administrator
Run homeowner association dues, violations and board reporting in the same tool as rentals

tools.name: Crypto (Septeo Solutions Immobilier)
tools.positioning: The incumbent French property administration suite — installed across a large share of professional syndic and gérance portfolios.
tools.description: Crypto, part of Septeo's real estate division, covers syndic, gérance and transaction for French property administrators: per-building and mandant accounting, calls for funds, assemblies, lease and receipt management, and extranets for co-owners, owners and tenants.
tools.real_estate_use: It is the system of record in many established French administration de biens firms, chosen for accounting depth rather than for interface. Its centre of gravity is the regulated ledger: separate accounts per copropriété, mandant funds kept distinct from the firm's own money, and the reporting a comptable and an auditor expect.
features: Syndic accounting per building with regulatory account structures
Gérance with mandant accounting and owner reddition de comptes
Calls for funds, budgets and assembly management
Lease, receipt and indexation handling
Co-owner, owner and tenant extranets
Transaction module and document management

use_cases.job: Keep regulated per-building accounts that satisfy an auditor
Produce owner reddition de comptes from mandant accounting rather than a spreadsheet

tools.name: DoorLoop
tools.positioning: The recent challenger — the same feature checklist as the incumbents, with an interface people learn in an afternoon.
tools.description: DoorLoop is a cloud property management platform covering rentals, associations and commercial portfolios: listings and screening, leases and e-signature, rent collection, maintenance, accounting with QuickBooks sync, and tenant and owner portals. It competes on usability and published pricing.
tools.real_estate_use: Its typical buyer is a manager leaving spreadsheets, or one leaving an older system whose interface their staff never mastered. The practical argument is onboarding time: a small team can go live in days, and the accounting exports cleanly to QuickBooks, which the bookkeeper already uses.
features: Listings, applications and tenant screening
Lease templates with e-signature and automated renewals
Online rent collection with automatic late fees
Maintenance requests, vendor assignment and tracking
Accounting with QuickBooks two-way sync
Tenant, owner and vendor portals

use_cases.job: Replace spreadsheets with a full system without a long onboarding
Collect rent, track maintenance and report to owners from one place

tools.name: Entrata
tools.positioning: A single-stack multifamily operating system — the accounting ledger and the leasing website are the same product, not an integration.
tools.description: Entrata is a multifamily-focused platform combining property accounting, leasing and marketing websites, resident portals, utility billing, insurance, revenue management and an AI leasing agent. Its architectural claim is one database behind every module rather than a suite assembled by acquisition.
tools.real_estate_use: Large apartment operators use it to run a lease-up and a stabilised asset on the same ledger. A prospect finds the community site, is answered by the AI leasing agent at midnight, tours, applies and signs — and the rent, concessions and renewal pricing all post to the same accounting without a nightly file transfer between systems.
features: Property accounting and general ledger for multifamily
Marketing websites and ILS syndication per community
AI leasing agent handling prospect enquiries and tour scheduling
Resident portal with payments, renewals and service requests
Revenue management and pricing optimisation
Utility billing, insurance and ancillary revenue modules

use_cases.job: Operate a large apartment portfolio with leasing, pricing and accounting on one database
Compare asset performance across a portfolio without reconciling systems

capabilities: AI leasing agent for enquiries and tours

tools.name: Gercop
tools.positioning: Property administration software for larger French firms, where volume and multi-site organisation are the constraint.
tools.description: Gercop, also part of Septeo, provides syndic, gérance and transaction management for French administration de biens: accounting, assemblies, calls for funds, lease management, extranets and business reporting, aimed at structures managing large portfolios.
tools.real_estate_use: At the scale of tens of thousands of lots across multiple branches, the operational problem moves from bookkeeping to organisation: who manages which building, which assemblies fall in which month, where arrears are concentrating. Gercop is bought for that management layer over the same regulated accounting base.
features: Syndic and gérance accounting at portfolio scale
Assembly planning and convocation across many buildings
Calls for funds, arrears tracking and recovery workflows
Lease management with indexation and charge regularisation
Multi-branch organisation and portfolio assignment
Management reporting and dashboards

use_cases.job: Plan and run assemblies across hundreds of buildings without losing deadlines
Track arrears concentration across a large managed portfolio

tools.name: Graneet
tools.positioning: Management software for French construction firms, built around the progress statement rather than the invoice.
tools.description: Graneet is a French SaaS for building and public works companies: quotes and bills of quantities, progress-based billing, purchase and subcontract tracking, site cost monitoring, cash flow forecasting and profitability analysis per site.
tools.real_estate_use: Construction firms in France bill by situation de travaux — a periodic statement of work completed — and their margin is decided by the gap between the estimate and the actual site cost. Graneet keeps both in one place, so a site foreman's committed purchases are visible against the quoted budget before the loss is realised at closing.
features: Quotes and bills of quantities with libraries
Progress-based billing and situations de travaux
Purchase orders and subcontract tracking
Site cost monitoring against the quoted budget
Cash flow forecasting and retention tracking
Profitability analysis per site and per client

use_cases.job: Bill by progress statement and see committed cost against the quote in real time
Forecast cash flow across sites including retentions and payment terms

tools.name: Horiz.io
tools.positioning: Rental investment analysis for the French private investor — yield, tax regime and cash flow before the offer is made.
tools.description: Horiz.io provides French rental investors with property analysis and simulation: gross and net yield calculation, comparison of tax regimes for furnished and unfurnished letting, financing and cash flow projection, plus portfolio tracking after acquisition.
tools.real_estate_use: In France the tax regime often decides whether an investment works — the same apartment can be cash-flow negative unfurnished and positive under a furnished regime with amortisation. Comparing those scenarios by hand is where private investors get it wrong. Horiz models them side by side before the offer, and then tracks the actual result afterwards.
features: Gross, net and net-of-tax yield calculation
Comparison of French rental tax regimes side by side
Financing and cash flow projection over the hold period
Renovation and works scenario modelling
Portfolio tracking after acquisition
Report generation for a financing application

use_cases.job: Compare furnished and unfurnished tax regimes on the same property before offering
Project cash flow over the hold period including financing and works

tools.name: Juniper Square
tools.positioning: Investor relations for private real estate funds — the capital account, the distribution and the portal in one place.
tools.description: Juniper Square provides fund administration and investor management for private real estate: subscriptions and onboarding, capital calls and distributions, waterfall calculations, investor reporting and an LP portal, with an administration service option.
tools.real_estate_use: A sponsor raising from private investors has to track ownership across entities, calculate a promote correctly, and produce K-1 packages and quarterly reports that LPs trust. Getting that wrong is a relationship problem, not a bookkeeping one. Juniper Square replaces the spreadsheet-and-mail-merge approach with an auditable system and a portal LPs log into.
features: Investor onboarding with electronic subscription documents
Capital calls, distributions and capital account tracking
Waterfall and promote calculation
LP portal with documents, statements and tax packages
Fund and deal-level performance reporting
Optional outsourced fund administration

use_cases.job: Run capital calls and distributions across many entities without spreadsheet risk
Give private investors a portal with their statements and tax documents

tools.name: Lone Wolf Back Office
tools.positioning: Brokerage accounting with trust and escrow handled to the standard a state auditor expects.
tools.description: The successor to brokerWOLF, Lone Wolf Back Office is a full brokerage accounting system — general ledger, accounts payable, trust and escrow accounting, commission processing and agent billing — designed around the regulatory particularities of real estate brokerage in the US and Canada.
tools.real_estate_use: Earnest money held on behalf of a client is not brokerage revenue, and a state regulator will test that distinction. Back Office keeps trust accounts reconciled and segregated, ties every deposit to a transaction, calculates the commission split at closing, and posts the result to a real general ledger instead of an export.
features: Real estate general ledger with trust and escrow accounting
Commission processing with splits, caps and deductions
Agent billing, chargebacks and 1099 preparation
Accounts payable and bank reconciliation
Franchise and multi-office consolidation reporting
Audit-oriented transaction-to-ledger traceability

use_cases.job: Keep trust accounts reconciled and defensible in a state audit
Consolidate financials across offices and franchise reporting requirements

tools.name: Lone Wolf Transactions
tools.positioning: The transaction product distributed by associations — for many US agents it is the forms platform that comes with membership.
tools.description: Lone Wolf Transactions, built on the former TransactionDesk and zipForm lineage, is widely provided as a member benefit through state and local REALTOR associations. It covers forms, e-signature (Authentisign), transaction folders and broker review, and connects to Lone Wolf's brokerage accounting products.
tools.real_estate_use: Because association distribution puts it in front of a very large share of US agents, it is often the default place a purchase agreement is drafted. A brokerage then layers broker review on top and pushes closed-deal data into Lone Wolf Back Office for commission calculation, so the same file drives both compliance and payroll.
features: zipForm and TransactionDesk form libraries via association membership
Authentisign e-signature
Transaction folders with broker review and compliance status
Templates and clause libraries per office
Handoff to Lone Wolf Back Office for commission accounting
MLS data prefill into forms

use_cases.job: Draft the state-approved contract set that came with association membership
Move a closed file straight into commission disbursement without re-keying

tools.name: Obat
tools.positioning: Quotes and invoices for the French artisan, with the regulatory mentions the trade actually needs.
tools.description: Obat is French SaaS for building trades: quotes with priced work libraries, invoices and progress billing, purchase and margin tracking, site follow-up, and the mandatory mentions required on construction documents including insurance and VAT rate handling.
tools.real_estate_use: A tradesperson's quote is a legal document: reduced VAT rates depend on the works and the age of the property, the décennale insurance reference must appear, and a renovation aid scheme may require specific wording. Obat encodes those rules so the artisan does not discover a defect when a client claims an aid and the paperwork is rejected.
features: Quotes with priced work and material libraries
Regulatory mentions including insurance and VAT rates
Invoices, deposits and progress billing
Purchase, supplier and margin tracking
Site and intervention follow-up
Client follow-up and payment reminders

use_cases.job: Issue quotes with the correct VAT rate and mandatory mentions for renovation work
Receive quotes documented well enough to claim a renovation aid scheme

tools.name: Ownily
tools.positioning: Accounting software for the French SCI — the structure most rental investors hold property in, and the one their accountant charges most for.
tools.description: Ownily is an online accounting service for French property-holding companies and rental investors: bank feed categorisation, real estate chart of accounts, amortisation, annual accounts and preparation of the tax returns required for SCI at corporation tax and for furnished letting regimes.
tools.real_estate_use: An SCI subject to corporation tax must keep double-entry accounts, amortise the building, and file a liasse fiscale — obligations most owners discover after buying. Ownily targets that specific compliance path, which is why it is bought instead of general accounting software that has no concept of a property component or a furnished-letting regime.
features: Bank feed import with real estate categorisation
Building and component amortisation schedules
Annual accounts for SCI and rental structures
Tax return preparation for the applicable regime
Partner and share ownership tracking
Rent, charge and works expense tracking

use_cases.job: Keep compliant SCI accounts and produce the annual liasse fiscale
Amortise a building correctly under a furnished letting or corporation tax regime

tools.name: Propertyware
tools.positioning: Built for scattered single-family rentals, where every door is a different address with a different owner.
tools.description: Propertyware is a management platform specialised in single-family and small residential portfolios: owner and tenant portals, a flexible accounting engine, mobile inspections, a maintenance module, and an open API used to wire in external marketing and screening.
tools.real_estate_use: Managing 800 scattered houses is not managing an 800-unit building. Every property has its own owner with its own management agreement, its own maintenance reserve and its own reporting expectations. Propertyware's accounting is built around that fragmentation, and its inspection app exists because staff spend the day driving between assets.
features: Owner-level accounting with per-property agreements and reserves
Mobile property inspections with photos
Maintenance workflow with vendor assignment and billing
Owner and tenant portals with online payments
Marketing syndication and lead tracking
Open API and custom field configuration

use_cases.job: Report to hundreds of individual owners on scattered single-family homes
Track maintenance reserves and net owner distributions per property

tools.name: Rent Manager
tools.positioning: The configurable one — for portfolios whose lease terms do not fit anybody's standard form.
tools.description: Rent Manager is a property management and accounting platform known for the depth of its configuration: user-defined fields, custom reports, a built-in contact centre, work order and asset tracking, and support for unusual property types including self-storage, marinas, manufactured housing and mixed portfolios.
tools.real_estate_use: It wins where the standard product breaks. A portfolio mixing apartments, commercial suites, storage units and ground leases has billing rules no template covers; Rent Manager lets an operator model them without leaving the accounting system. The trade-off is that someone has to own the configuration.
features: Configurable accounting with user-defined fields and custom reports
Support for storage, marina, manufactured housing and mixed portfolios
Work order, inspection and fixed-asset tracking
Built-in phone system and contact centre
Tenant and owner portals with online payments
Open API and extensive integration marketplace

use_cases.job: Model non-standard billing across a mixed-asset portfolio inside the accounting system
Track work orders and equipment against the same property records as the leases

tools.name: SkySlope
tools.positioning: Built for the broker's compliance problem first, and the agent's paperwork second.
tools.description: SkySlope is a transaction and compliance platform for brokerages, with digital forms (SkySlope Forms), e-signature (DigiSign), offer management (Offers) and broker audit workflows. Its centre of gravity is the file review queue rather than the agent experience.
tools.real_estate_use: A brokerage with a legal obligation to retain complete files uses SkySlope to enforce what "complete" means. Each transaction type carries a required-document checklist, files route to a reviewer, rejections come back with a reason, and the archive survives a state audit years later. Listing and sale files are separated so a listing that never sells is still auditable.
features: Broker file review with per-transaction-type document checklists
SkySlope Forms with state and association form libraries
DigiSign e-signature bound to the transaction file
Offers — structured offer submission and comparison for listing agents
Commission and back-office module
Retention-grade archive with full audit history

use_cases.job: Guarantee that every closed file is audit-complete before it is archived
Collect and compare multiple offers on a listing in a structured view

tools.name: Stessa
tools.positioning: Accounting written for the rental investor rather than for the accountant — free, and organised by property.
tools.description: Stessa tracks rental property income and expenses through linked bank accounts, categorises transactions to a real estate chart of accounts, stores documents, and produces owner-level dashboards and tax-ready reports. The core product is free.
tools.real_estate_use: The individual investor's real problem is Schedule E: proving, a year later, which transaction belonged to which property. Stessa auto-categorises bank activity by property, keeps receipts attached, and produces the tax package. It is bookkeeping shaped by how a landlord actually thinks — per door, not per account.
features: Automatic transaction import and categorisation by property
Property-level income, expense and cash flow dashboards
Document storage attached to properties and transactions
Tax-ready reports including Schedule E preparation
Rent collection and tenant screening options
Portfolio valuation tracking

use_cases.job: Produce a tax-ready Schedule E package per property without a bookkeeper
See real cash flow per door rather than one blended bank balance

tools.name: Visual Lease
tools.positioning: Lease accounting compliance first — for the tenant side, where a lease is a balance sheet liability.
tools.description: Visual Lease is a lease administration and lease accounting platform aimed at occupiers and corporate real estate teams. It maintains a lease repository with critical dates and clauses, and produces the journal entries and disclosures required by ASC 842, IFRS 16 and GASB 87.
tools.real_estate_use: Since IFRS 16 and ASC 842, a company that rents two hundred stores carries those leases on its balance sheet, and the auditor tests the calculation. Visual Lease exists because that computation cannot survive in a spreadsheet: every modification, renewal option and discount rate change has to be re-measured and evidenced.
features: Central lease repository with clauses and critical dates
ASC 842, IFRS 16 and GASB 87 calculation and disclosure reporting
Journal entry generation and ERP export
Lease modification and remeasurement handling
Rent payment scheduling and recovery review
Portfolio dashboards for occupancy cost

use_cases.job: Produce audit-ready lease accounting entries for a multi-country lease portfolio
Never miss a renewal or break option across hundreds of sites

tools.name: Yardi Breeze
tools.positioning: Yardi's accounting rigour, stripped of the implementation project that Voyager requires.
tools.description: Yardi Breeze and Breeze Premier are the self-service tier of Yardi's platform, aimed at small and mid-sized managers across residential, commercial, affordable and self-storage portfolios. Setup is guided rather than consultant-led, and pricing is published per unit with a monthly minimum.
tools.real_estate_use: Chosen by managers who want Yardi's accounting model — property-level ledgers, owner draws, CAM reconciliation in the Premier tier — without a six-month Voyager implementation. It is also the natural landing point for firms that expect to grow into Voyager later and want the data model to be familiar.
features: Property accounting with owner payments and reporting
Online applications, leases and rent collection
Maintenance requests and vendor work orders
Marketing with RentCafe listing syndication
Commercial features including CAM reconciliation in Premier
Resident and owner portals

use_cases.job: Get real property accounting without a consultant-led implementation
Manage a mixed residential and small commercial portfolio in one ledger

tools.name: Yardi Voyager
tools.positioning: The institutional system of record — where the lease, the ledger and the investor report are the same data.
tools.description: Voyager is Yardi's enterprise platform, deployed across commercial, multifamily, affordable, senior and student portfolios worldwide. It combines property accounting, lease administration, budgeting and forecasting, investment management and a large ecosystem of add-on modules, with localisations including France.
tools.real_estate_use: For an institutional owner, the question is not features but audit chain: the rent invoiced to a tenant, the indexation clause applied, the accrual booked and the figure reported to the fund's investors must all descend from one record. Voyager is bought for that continuity, and implementations run in months because the configuration encodes a firm's entire operating model.
features: Commercial and residential lease administration with clause handling
Property, corporate and investment accounting with multi-currency
Budgeting, forecasting and valuation workflows
Investment management and investor reporting
Maintenance, procurement and energy modules
Country localisations including French accounting and VAT treatment

use_cases.job: Report to fund investors from the same ledger that invoices the tenants
Administer indexation, recoveries and CAM reconciliation across a commercial portfolio
